My recommendation

Best for most people: Soundcore Space One at $80 with code AFSC20.

Best for flights and commuting: Soundcore Space Q45.

Best if you hate heavy headphones: Sony WH-CH720N.

Best if battery life is your priority: Edifier W820NB Plus.

One caveat: budget ANC headphones generally do a better job reducing steady low-frequency sounds, such as airplane engines, than eliminating every voice or sudden noise.

If I were choosing one pair today, I'd buy the Soundcore Space One at the $80 promotional price, provided the code still works at checkout.
